title: Trivialized-test comparison for prescribed graded line fractions
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes, $h:T\to S$ a morphism, $A$ affine-basis quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_S$-algebra data, $L$ an $\mathcal O_T$-module, and $\psi$ a relative graded line map from $A$ to the tensor powers of $L$ over $h$ [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map]. For every open $W\subset T$, section $l\in\Gamma(W,L)$, and integer $n\ge0$, supply $P(l,n)\in\Gamma(W,L^{\otimes n})$ with $P(l,0)=1$ and $P(l,n+1)=l\otimes P(l,n)$. Let coefficients $c$ satisfy $c_{U,W,l}(a)P(l,n)=\psi_U(a)|_W$ on every affine free-frame open. Let the maps $\rho_i$ of [def-trf-graded-line-fraction-chart] satisfy its fraction formula. Suppose a morphism $F:T\to\operatorname{Proj}_S(A)$ is already given and $F\circ s_i=t_i$ for every chart index. Let $j:B\to T$ be an open immersion, $V\subset S$ affine with $h(j(B))\subset V$, and $e:j^*L\simeq\mathcal O_B$ a trivialization. Let $\alpha:A(V)\to\Gamma(B,\mathcal O_B)$ send each homogeneous element of degree $n$ to the coefficient of $\psi$ evaluated on $B$ in the $n$th power of $e$. If the image of the irrelevant ideal under $\alpha$ generates the unit ideal, then $F\circ j=i_V\circ\operatorname{Proj.fromOfGlobalSections}(\alpha)$. This compares an existing morphism on a single trivialized test; it asserts neither existence of $F$ nor its structural equation over $S$.

theorem gradedLineFraction_test
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {h : T ⟶ S} {A : S.GradedAlgebraData} {L : T.Modules}
    (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L)
    (P : ∀ {W : T.Opens}, Γ(L, W) → (n : ℕ) → Γ(L.tensorPow n, W))
    (hP0 : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)), P l 0 = unitSectionsEquiv W 1)
    (hPs : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ),
      P l (n + 1) = tmulSection l (P l n))
    (c : GradedLineFractionCoefficients h A L)
    (hc : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l → ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U n),
      c U W hWU l n a • P l n =
        (L.tensorPow n).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ψ.component U n a))
    (ρ : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grading i.U) i.e.val →+*
        Localization.Away (i.coefficient c))
    (hρ : GradedLineFractionChart.FractionFormula c ρ)
    (F : T ⟶ A.relProj)
    (hF : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L, i.source c ≫ F = i.target c ρ)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ T) (hj : IsOpenImmersion j)
    (V : S.affineOpens) (q : (⊤ : W.Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1))
    (e : (tensorPullback j).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)
    (α : A.obj V →+* Γ(W, ⊤))
    (hα : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading V n), α a =
      (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤).symm
        ((AlgebraicSpace.trivializedPower e n).hom.app ⊤ (ψ.evaluate j V q n a)))
    (hαgen : Ideal.map α (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (A.grading V)).toIdeal = ⊤) :
    j ≫ F = Proj.fromOfGlobalSections (A.grading V) α hαgen ≫ A.relProjι V
